questions.q: In a certain code language, 'OXYGEN' is written as 'QZAIGP', and 'MIND' is written as 'OKPF'. how will 'DOCTOR' be written in that language?
Which of the following codes represents 'Seema' in the coded language?
o: Either qr or xy
Either jk or Ir
questions.s:
Reference:

"House is too expensive" is coded as "ma rs tn nq"……..(1)

"Seema felt awful too" is coded as "jk Ir ps rs"……..(2)

"Car looks expensive" is coded as "qr xy nq"……..(3)

"This is awful" is coded as "qp tn ps"……..(4)

Inference:

From (1) and (4), we get:

Is → tn……..(5)

From (1) and (2), we get:

Too → rs……..(6)

From (1) and (3), we get:

Expensive → nq……..(7)

From (1), (5), (6) and (7), we get:

House → ma……..(8)

From (2) and (4), we get:

Awful → ps……..(9)

From (2), (6) and (9), we get:

Seema → jk/lr……..(10)

Felt → lr/jk……..(11)

From (3) and (7), we get:

Car → qr/xy……..(12)

Looks → xy/qr……..(13)

From (4), (5) and (9), we get:

This → qp……..(14)

The code for “Seema” is either “jk” or “lr”.
